verdict.rationale: HubSpot's docs mention customizable sales reports and dashboards (hubspot-docs-34, hubspot-docs-42, hubspot-docs-36/43) that could surface pipeline value and stage data, but there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated revenue forecasting feature that uses stage probabilities and close dates to project future revenue. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a forecasting tool/report tied to deal stage probability and close date, independent confirmation of forecast accuracy or usage, and any hands-on validation of forecast outputs.
